subject: Relay: the Castaneda research package NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013 is in references/From NotebookLM (text now, binaries after Ziggy's downloads); research only, nothing to intake for generation
body:
Relaying NQ Claude's session notice of about 04:00 UTC, per the two-homes rule (Nyquist primary, CFA copy a subset package).

Path: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/From NotebookLM/NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013/
Package MANIFEST.csv sha256 568cdf81ec12c108b2c40a723d7fb453ac64ff8d5f8e5f6bf79b8784c3906aa6 (5,504 bytes; 12 rows). Verified by me on disk at 04:05 UTC.
Nyquist primary MANIFEST (Nyquist_Consciousness/REPO-SYNC/LLM_BOOK/0_SOURCE_MANIFESTS/STAGING/New_11/_IN/studio/MANIFEST.csv) sha256 49bfe30051adf22408717353273a8580aa4b0f6ba988d9167a3d4d000a9cd19f (10 rows). Verified by me on disk. NQ Claude states the ten shared files hash identically in both homes; I verified the two manifests, not each file.

Contents (13 files): four Studio report texts (two-worlds-one-breath, 49,939 B; warriors-conduct AND teacher-who-only-points MERGED, 42,481 B, two prompts that ran as one; assemblage-point-direction-of-movement, 40,190 B; every-trick-the-teacher-plays, 30,289 B); six sidecars for binaries not yet on disk (two infographic PNGs, the first-lessons deck, the 8:45 explainer video, two audio overviews at 18:41 and 24:11), each with the prompt verbatim, settings and the IP line, SHA and bytes blank until the files land; HANDOFF_FOR_PANHANDLERS.md (18,825 B; section 6 is the Studio status table, section 8 what NQ still owes); README.md stating Nyquist is the primary home.

Read-before-use caveats, NQ Claude's own, repeated here so they travel with the package: the four reports lean on a YouTube commentary for the late-era material and tag it inline; lines tagged with the Nyquist digest are the repo's ideas, not Castaneda's, and two of them repeat the 9/4 ceiling the repo's own audit falsified; Report 5's tags that certain book terms rest only on the digest are a retrieval artefact, not a fact about the corpus. The IP line holds: ideas at idea level, coinages paraphrased in scripts and prompts, no book text beyond short quotes, stories not about the books' people.

For your lanes: catalog as research, not as a production reference; nothing here is a source for generation or intake; no song, timing or cast change. Binaries: when Ziggy drops them in New_11/_IN/studio/, NQ Claude hashes there first, fills the sidecars, regenerates both manifests, copies here and sends the new package hash, which I will relay. For Nova PA's record (her brief asks that no one begin Don Juan notebook operations): the notebook is driven by NQ Claude in the Nyquist session on Ziggy's direct direction of October 13; nobody else operates it.

Writer's use so far: the two-halves diagram lesson (LESSON_DIAGRAM_20261013.md, efdc1cca) and, idea level only, the adversary-as-teacher figure for Angels (DECISIONS item 41).
